method: Combined reference extraction including cheek/jaw outline; image-edit tool output is not a pixel-identical cutout

attempts.prompt: Edit the supplied approved happy-face reference by extracting its existing face details together on ONE transparent RGBA canvas. This is a preservation/extraction task, not a new facial design. KEEP AS ONE REGISTERED GROUP: both existing closed happy eyes including the rounded dark eyelash arcs, tiny opaque white glints and short fine mauve eyelid creases; both existing soft pink cheek blush gradients and diagonal blush hatch marks; existing pink open smile with its thin border and shaded interior; tiny existing nose dot; the existing thin outer face contour along the cheeks and entire rounded jaw/chin. Preserve ALL their original relative sizes, spacing, locations, facial balance and line shapes. Preserve the square composition with original 970x970 reference layout; no recentering, zooming or spreading parts into a sheet. The chin tip is near (504,697), nose (491,459), eyes approximately left (275,360) and right (710,350), mouth (495,550). Remove all skin fill, hair, eyebrows, neck, collar, jewelry, clothing and background to real transparency. KEEP the fine contour line only, no opaque skin silhouette or skin patches. Where hair obscures the cheek contour, extend just that thin line naturally to connect to the existing visible jaw, without changing the visible chin outline, widening or slimming the face; stop the cheek contour around eye height and do not invent a forehead oval. Delete hair outlines, including pointed hair strands touching cheeks. Soft blush should have translucent feathered edges, not opaque white/pale skin patches. Eyes and mouth white glints retain their pigment. Every blank area inside and outside the face must be truly transparent. Do not sharpen lashes, enlarge eyes, change their arcs or replace the smile. ONE combined transparent image containing the two eyes, two blushes, nose, mouth and thin cheek/jaw outline in situ. No text, no checkerboard pixels.

attempts.prompt: Perform a minimally changed image edit of the supplied approved happy face. Erase everything EXCEPT its EXISTING facial expression marks and its EXISTING visible cheek/jaw contour line, leaving those together in their original locations on a true transparent background. This must look like the original face has simply had its skin fill and hair removed, NOT a redesign or newly illustrated set of parts. Keep BOTH closed happy eyelash curves, delicate short upper eyelid creases, small white lash highlights, BOTH soft original cheek blush gradients and short diagonal hatch strokes, tiny nose dot, original small pink smiling mouth, and original thin jaw/chin outline. Preserve exactly their relative scale and spacing: original 970 square frame, chin at (504,697), nose (491,459), mouth bounds roughly (434,525)-(555,584), left-eye artwork bounds (154,300)-(400,410), right-eye artwork bounds (595,295)-(835,402), blush centers (275,443) and (712,437). Preserve the same margins and layout on the square canvas; do not zoom, recenter or widen the face. Keep the rounded broad original chin, NOT a sharp V shape. Keep the rounded eyelash arcs, NOT pointed extra spikes. Most critically blush is ONLY the faint translucent pink pigment plus hatch marks: REMOVE all white/cream skin and skin shadow beneath it. Do not make white disks under the eyes. Hair, hairline, hair shadow, eyebrows, skin, neck, collar, jewelry and clothes must be fully erased to transparency. Extract the existing thin cheek/jaw perimeter WITHOUT hair outlines; do not extend forehead or complete a full oval, and do not change the visible original jaw line. Only minimal hidden cheek-line completion where needed, with existing visible jaw unchanged. All retained features stay together as ONE sparse transparent image in their original arrangement. This is one shared registered extraction for testing face proportion, NOT a separated parts sheet. No opaque face area, no checkerboard pixels, no labels.
